Generate a Stics workspace from SMS data, for evaluation and calibration.

Source: R/gen_workspace_from_sms.R
gen_workspace_from_sms.Rd

Generate a Stics workspace from SMS data, for evaluation and calibration.

Usage

gen_workspace_from_sms(
  sms_path,
  stics_path,
  output_dir,
  usms = NULL,
  parallel = FALSE,
  cores = NA,
  force_code_shape = TRUE,
  verbose = 1L,
  usms_files = lifecycle::deprecated()
)

Arguments

sms_path

path to the SMS repository

stics_path

path to Stics repository

output_dir

path to the Stics workspace to generate

usms

character vector of USM names to generate. If NULL (default), all evaluation and calibration USMs are generated. Use read_usms_files to read them from USM list files.

parallel

Boolean. Is the computation to be done in parallel ?

cores

Number of cores to use for parallel computation

force_code_shape

Boolean. Should the code_shape parameter be forced to 2 for intercrop plant files (see set_intercrop_code_shape) ? Default TRUE.

verbose

Integer. Logging verbosity level: 0 = warnings and errors only, 1 = info, 2 = debug

usms_files

Deprecated. Use usms = read_usms_files(usms_files) instead.

Value

NULL (invisibly)
